required_transformations: Aggregate daily signup counts by city_tier and signup_date
Compute conversion rate by acquisition_channel using converted_flag
Calculate 7-day retention by cohort_week using retained_7d_flag
Remove all personally identifiable information and raw identifiers
justification: All business questions are aggregate KPI questions that can be answered with aggregated outputs only
Policy requires minimum necessary data release; raw user-level export is not needed for aggregate analysis
Credential fields (password_hash, auth_token) must never be released externally
Derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) are sufficient and preferred over raw timestamps
